newsitem.title: CHINA: China arrests suspected leader of Xinjiang riot.
newsitem.headline: China arrests suspected leader of Xinjiang riot.

text.p: Chinese police have arrested the suspected leader of riots last week by mainly Moslem ethnic Uighurs in northwestern Xinjiang, a local Communist Party official said on Wednesday.

The 29-year-old Uighur, identified only as Heilili, had been arrested and was under interrogation following the riots last Wednesday and Thursday in Yining near China's border with Kazakhstan, said the official of the Yining party committee.
The suspect was unemployed, and was a ringleader of a similar, less violent anti-Chinese demonstration in Yining last August, the official said.
The official said Heilili had been released after that demonstration following "ideological education" -- a codeword for political indoctrination.
Officials said 200 to 300 people had been rounded up by police since the riots in which at least 10 people were killed and 144 injured.
